title: Lars Ö NDE 661
content:
I have a problem and my doctors don't know what it is - my heart races. I've had problems since 1984 with recurring attacks. Sometimes I get totally knocked out. In the beginning, I only had a few attacks. Recently they've become more frequent. The problem is that when the heart slows down and becomes normal, it apparently stops for a while. I've been very deep when it happened the first time, lost part of the memory, but the other time has burned into my memory forever. I got a kind of floating feeling, like if you were about to fly away. I could see myself from the outside, and got a weird feeling of a presence, like I wasn't alone - like someone took me by the hand and led me to the spiral or tunnel where I'd never been before. Suddenly I was there, and then I wasn't in control of my life anymore. Rather, there was something else that I don't know what it is. Suddenly, I was in the tunnel and that state was horrible, no matter how hard you try to explain it you can't. It wasn't a question of wanting it or not, you just went straight down into it (the tunnel). It wasn't round, but had jagged segments in several layers that surrounded you on all sides. Zigzag shaped segments, or something like that, bathed in the same intensive light. It was like black in between or something, don't know if it was an empty space there. I got very dizzy, like everything was spinning around, and at the same time I had a feeling like I was standing still. I don't know how long it lasted, but it was long and the feeling was awful and painful. I can't describe the torment. It wasn't of this world. There was a visual impression I got I'll never forget as long as I live - you can describe the tunnel like you were stuck, you can't move, and at the same time it's like you're stretched out in some way. I don't know how. Although you don't have your normal feelings, you apparently have soul feelings, but I still can't talk about the emotional part, it still hurts when I think about it. When you come out of the spiral on the other side, it's dark with lots of white dots that move towards you. It feels like you're hurled outwards at a high speed - don't know how far I got out there - but it lasted for a long time. Then I started thinking, if I go on I'll be stuck here, and then I woke up lying on the floor. I don't know if it was a dream or reality. Since then I've acquired a new ability, I can see plants and trees and also clouds in the sky (psychically), I've seen people and animals. I could never do that before. Precognitive ability comes more often now than before; sometimes, I can see three or five weeks ahead, none of it has been wrong yet, but I can't control it. When I see trees, they are of supernatural beauty, and when they've got snow on them all the ice crystals have the flat side turned towards you, you can't see anything at the edges and the trees don't seem to have roots. It can't be dreams. The strange thing is I was standing in a fir forest and felt the smell of firs (during the experience), but I still don't remember seeing anything before or after the tunnel, and still I could smell firs at home for a long time afterwards. I've had three experiences like that afterwards, but now I know for sure I've been on another level than this one. Everything I see is real, you can't explain it in any other way than that there is something after (death). I'm totally sure of it. You can't explain it away; you can't see something that's never happened before. My outlook on life has changed completely; I've become humble and emotional and open after these experiences. I'm psychic, have always seen things which are difficult to explain, but at the same time I thought they were natural. I have often seen a mountain or alp with the three lights, this has been both a frightening and wonderful experience, the mountain has a strong light in the middle and on the left side a small light and a similar one on the right side. On the right side, between the middle and the right light, there is a cloud or whatever it is, you can't say it's black or grey, it's hard to explain what it's like. It's like bubbly at the edges all around, and at the same time it radiates both good and evil. If you think good thoughts, then goodness and peace radiate and if you don't think right, a beast appears in the middle light. The middle light is bigger and the light is extremely intensive, it's either white or bluish-white: It's hard to explain, an unnatural light. From the light, horizontally, there is a two-armed spiral emerging, not compressed, but expanded like a DNA spiral. It is funnel shaped, narrow by the light and broader further out, and it slowly rotates around clockwise with a humming sound, a very low-frequency sound, which gives an uncomfortable feeling of aversion, and there's no connection to the ground between whatever it is and the spiral, and it's like a fog or haze. This is how far I've got with my usual psychic ability.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: “a kind of floating feeling, like if you were about to fly away.”

tunnel.passage_other_detail: “spiral or tunnel” with “jagged segments in several layers… Zigzag shaped segments… bathed in the same intensive light… like black in between.”
tunnel.movement_other_detail: “you just went straight down into it”; “very dizzy, like everything was spinning around… and… standing still”; “stuck… can’t move… stretched out.”

environment.environment_other_detail: “dark with lots of white dots that move towards you”; later mentions (as psychic perceptions) “mountain or alp with the three lights… extremely intensive… white or bluish-white… two-armed spiral… funnel shaped… humming sound… fog or haze.”

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He thought: “if I go on I’ll be stuck here,” then he “woke up lying on the floor.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Heart problem: “my heart races… when the heart slows down and becomes normal, it apparently stops for a while… Sometimes I get totally knocked out.”

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Other: dark space with “white dots”; strong aversive low-frequency humming (described in later psychic vision).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE → presence/being leads him → tunnel/spiral → dark space with moving white dots → return/wakes on floor.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: “I’ve had three experiences like that afterwards.”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel described as jagged/zigzag layered segments with intense light and black gaps; post-NDE lingering smell of firs at home; later recurrent psychic vision of a three-light mountain/alp with a DNA-like rotating spiral and humming sound responsive to thoughts (good vs beast).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could see myself from the outside”; “like someone took me by the hand and led me to the spiral or tunnel”; “that state was horrible… I can’t describe the torment”; “dark with lots of white dots that move towards you”; “I don’t know if it was a dream or reality.”
